description: This file provides stubbed data providers for Near-Earth Objects (NEOs) and planetary positions, used in a larger astronomical or space tracking project. It contains functions to generate deterministic mock data based on input dates, meant for testing or development purposes.

methods.name: datetime _parse_date(date_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a date string in YYYY-MM-DD format to a datetime object, validating the format.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict],Dict] get_neos_for_date(date: str, page: int = 1, per_page: int = 10)
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of stub NEO data for a specified date, with mock details such as velocity, distance, and hazard potential.

methods.name: List[Dict] get_planets_for_date(date: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of stub planetary positions (names, right ascension, declination, distance) for a given date.
